confirm.title: Plan the {commute} commute's route again
confirm.description:
The {commute} commute was planned by an earlier version, which only knew Ontario 511's highways: its route uses straight lines between them, the start and the end, and doesn't follow the roads you drive. Its corridor, and the events, conditions and closures its summary shows, can be off as a result.

Select **Submit** to find up to three routes along the roads between its two areas' centres, which are sent to OpenStreetMap's routing service. The fastest becomes the commute's route, and items along all three are added. Existing items stay; delete any you don't need from the integration page. Routes © OpenStreetMap contributors.
